author: sjgadler
text: Deeply respect the public reversal on this. It has pained me to see how Ilya has been portrayed in media: I find him so thoughtful and earnest in trying to do right; he also seemed absolutely distraught in the wake of Sam’s dismissal, not coup-like in the least. Again, respect.

quoted.text: I deeply regret my participation in the board's actions. I never intended to harm OpenAI. I love everything we've built together and I will do everything I can to reunite the company.

author: sjgadler
text: We should get a decibel meter for @sama’s first appearance back at an All-Hands - it’s going to be ⚡️⚡️⚡️

quoted.text:
We have reached an agreement in principle for Sam Altman to return to OpenAI as CEO with a new initial board of Bret Taylor (Chair), Larry Summers, and Adam D'Angelo.

We are collaborating to figure out the details. Thank you so much for your patience through this.
